verdict.rationale: The first-party docs say moq-relay is a server you can deploy anywhere and use to build a self-hosted CDN cluster, with a private CDN as an option. The repo is open on GitHub, and a community production deployment (SageOx) shows a relay run outside the vendor's hosted service. Missing for 10: detailed self-hosting install/ops documentation in the pack (deployment steps, system requirements, licensing terms), and independent corroboration that explicitly describes self-hosting rather than implying it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: A server connecting publishers to subscribers, able to form a [self-hosted CDN cluster](/bin/relay/cluster.html).
You can optionally self-host a private CDN or end-to-end encrypt your content.
Host your own CDN, use a 3rd party service, and/or connect P2P via Iroh (native only).
The default demo starts a relay, publishes a test video, and opens the web player.
